sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Boreas is a story chapter in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Obtain a Paradigm Shipping poster or check the distress signal via the radio system at the Intelligence Center level 3 in the Hideout.

sections.heading: Guide
Talk to Mechanic
sections.text: Visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the distress signal.

sections.heading: Locate and repair the equipment under the cellular tower on Woods
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Toolset | 1 | Required | N/A | This item is used to repair the equipment. When used, the item is removed from the players' inventory. |

Find and repair the equipment at the Scav bunker on Woods with a Toolset.

sections.heading: Report back to Mechanic
sections.text: Visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen.

sections.heading: Locate and obtain the Paradigm Shipping documentation
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Paradigm Shipping directive | 1 | Required | Yes |

The Paradigm Shipping directive to pick up and read can be found in the warehouse at the freight yard in the north of Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Tell Mechanic about "Boreas"
sections.text: Visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen.

sections.heading: Arrange a transport to the icebreaker
sections.text:
Visit Prapor in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the transport.

| The next objectives depend on your choice, or respectively progress in Falling Skies. |

sections.heading: Hand over 3 Military power filters to Prapor
sections.text:
This objective only happens if you kept the Armored case from Prapor in Falling Skies.
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Military power filter | 3 | Handover item | Yes |

sections.heading: Eliminate any 30 targets on Reserve
sections.text: This objective only happens if you have not completed Falling Skies.

sections.heading: Launch a yellow signal flare at the Woods transit on Reserve
sections.text:
This objective only happens if you have not completed Falling Skies.
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in Raid | Notes |
| RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Yellow) | 1 | Required | N/A | Must be fired into the sky while being at the transit. |
| ZiD SP-81 26x75 signal pistol | 1 | Required | N/A | Used to fire the flare cartridge. |
| 26x75mm flare cartridge (Yellow) | 1 | Required | N/A | Must be fired into the sky while being at the transit. |
Shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being at the Woods transit on Reserve. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you.

sections.heading: Hand over the AMG-10 fluid to Prapor
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| AMG-10 hydraulic fluid (quest item) | 1 | Handover item | Yes |

The AMG-10 hydraulic fluid (quest item) can be found on Reserve. There are multiple possible spawns throughout the location. Note: The barter item AMG-10 hydraulic fluid cannot be used for this objective.

sections.heading: Find an alternative transport to the icebreaker
sections.text:
Talk to the BTR Driver and ask him about the transport.

| The next objectives depend on your choice, or respectively progress in the BTR Driver questline. |

sections.text:
This objective only happens if you have completed The Price of Independence.

Exit the raid by extracting or dying.

sections.text:
This objective only happens if you have completed Choose Your Friends Wisely.
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in Raid |

sections.heading: Locate and obtain Skier's reports on Customs
sections.text:
This objective only happens if you have completed Choose Your Friends Wisely.
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Skier's docs | 1 | Required | Yes |

Skier's docs can be found in the ditch between the Scav base and the laboratory on Customs.

sections.heading: Burn Skier's reports on Customs
sections.text:
This objective only happens if you have completed Choose Your Friends Wisely.

Burn Skier's docs at any fire barrel on Customs. The closest one to the pick up location is in the middle living quarters of the Scav base.

sections.heading: Eliminate any 15 targets at the smugglers' territories
sections.text:
This objective only happens if you have completed Choose Your Friends Wisely.

Kill any 15 targets at the smuggler bases on Shoreline or Interchange.

sections.heading: Eliminate any 10 targets at the smugglers' territories
sections.text:
This objective only happens if you have not completed either The Price of Independence or Choose Your Friends Wisely.

Kill any 10 targets at the smuggler bases on Shoreline or Interchange.

sections.heading: Return to the BTR driver
sections.text: Talk to the BTR Driver.

sections.heading: Tell Mechanic that you found transport to the icebreaker
sections.text: Visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen.

sections.heading: Board the smuggler hovercraft on Shoreline or Lighthouse
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in Raid |
| Sudak-Tudak marine repair kit | 1 | Required | N/A |
The hovercraft is located at the piers on Shoreline and Lighthouse. It can only be boarded while carrying a Sudak-Tudak marine repair kit. To extract from the icebreaker, a green flare and 2,400 Euros are required.

sections.heading: Arrive at the Icebreaker
sections.text: Access Icebreaker through the Shoreline or Lighthouse transit.

sections.heading: Check if any crew members survived on the ship
sections.text: Talk to the scientist through the intercom located on level 1 of the Icebreaker on the east side of the ship.

sections.heading: Access the engine room
sections.text: Access the engine room by using the Boreas engine room keycard. Once the player reaches halfway through the engine room, Black Division operatives will come out of doors on the catwalks in front of the player.

sections.heading: Locate and obtain the engine room keycard
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Boreas engine room keycard | 1 | Unlocks the engine room door | N/A |
The engine room keycard is located in the center medical room at level 1, next to an engineer body.

sections.heading: Reach the engine room
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Boreas engine room keycard | 1 | Unlocks the engine room door | N/A |
Head to level 0 on the east side of the ship and find the locked door with a keycard reader right next to the control room.

Continue to navigate the ship, and take the stairs to level 1 to find the doors to the engine room. Unseal them then enter the room and go downstairs to level -2.

sections.heading: Find a way into the icebreaker superstructure
sections.text:
The player needs to go to the extraction zone, but instead of extracting, go two levels down, turn around the helipad, and go all the way to the side of the ship, and go up to level 3 to find a door with a chain.

A group of Black Division operatives will be waiting for the player on the helipad, and another group under the helipad.

Once you reach the objective, try to open the damaged door locked with chains and you will be asked to find an explosive. You can now extract from the Icebreaker. At this point the quest Stick to It is unlocked.

sections.heading: Ask Mechanic about explosives
sections.text: Visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen.

sections.heading: Ask Prapor about explosives
sections.text: Visit Prapor in the menu through the trader screen.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: - Unlocks purchase of SZ-1 explosive charge (Icebreaker) at Prapor LL1

sections.heading: Reach the damaged door on the roof of the engine room
sections.text: The player needs to get back to the damaged door with chains.

sections.heading: Break the chain on the door on the roof of the engine room using the SZ-1 charge
sections.text:
| Related Quest Items |
| Icon | Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| SZ-1 explosive charge (Icebreaker) | SZ-1 explosive charge | 1 | Used to break the chains.; Can be purchased at Prapor LL1. | N/A |
Once the player reaches the damaged door, equipped with SZ-1 explosive charge (Icebreaker) the chain can be destroyed after placing the charge on it.

sections.heading: Enter the icebreaker superstructure from the roof of the engine room
sections.text: After the door, the player need to enter the crew quarter. Be aware,The Wedge squad is present within the crew quarter. A teargas grenade is setup as a tripwire trap at the entrance door of the quarters.

sections.heading: Find a way to the upper decks of the icebreaker superstructure
sections.text: Once the crew quarter have been cleared and The Wedge killed, head to level 5 of the ship and get outside of the quarters to take the stairs and find a code-locked door leading to the upper decks.

sections.heading: Ask the surviving scientist how to open the code-locked door on level 6
sections.text: Talk to the scientist through the intercom located on level 1 of the Icebreaker on the east side of the ship.

sections.heading: Ask Mechanic for help with finding the second part of the code for the locked door on level 6
sections.text: Visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen.

sections.heading: Plant the hacking device in the server room in The Lab
sections.text:
| If you have already planted the Local network hacking device in the Blue Fire story chapter, this objective auto-completes. |
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Local network hacking device | 1 | Required | N/A | Stashed item |
The Local network hacking device has to be stashed in the server room on the first floor of The Lab. Mechanic provides one via in-game mail and has a barter for more available.

sections.heading: Return to Mechanic
sections.text: Visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen.

sections.heading: Arrive at the Icebreaker
sections.text: Access Icebreaker through the Shoreline transit or through the menu.

sections.heading: Access the engine room
sections.text: Access the engine room by using the Boreas engine room keycard. Once the player reaches halfway of the engine room, Black Division operatives will come out of doors on the catwalks in front of the player.

sections.heading: Locate and obtain the engine room keycard
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Boreas engine room keycard | 1 | Unlocks the engine room door | N/A |
The engine room keycard is located in the center medical room at level 1 next to an engineer body.

sections.heading: Reach the engine room
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Boreas engine room keycard | 1 | Unlocks the engine room door | N/A |
Head to level 0 on the east side of the ship and find the locked door with a keycard reader right next to the control room.

Continue to navigate the ship, and take the stairs to level 1 to find the doors to the engine room. Unseal them then enter the room and go downstairs to level -2.

sections.heading: Reach the damaged door on the roof of the engine room
sections.text: The player needs to get back to the damaged door with chains.

sections.heading: Break the chain on the door on the roof of the engine room using the SZ-1 charge
sections.text:
| Related Quest Items |
| Icon | Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| SZ-1 explosive charge (Icebreaker) | SZ-1 explosive charge | 1 | Used to break the chains.; Can be purchased at Prapor LL1. | N/A |
Once the player reaches the damaged door, equipped with SZ-1 explosive charge (Icebreaker) the chain can be destroyed after placing the charge on it.

sections.heading: Reach the code-locked door
sections.text: Once the crew quarters have been cleared and The Wedge killed, head to level 5 of the ship and get outside of the quarters to take the stairs and find a code-locked door leading to the upper decks.

sections.heading: Use the correct access code
sections.text: Use the code 3-1-2-2-2-0 on the pad to unlock the door. The code is the same every raid, does not change, and is the same for every door of the zone that leads to the exterior.

sections.heading: Locate compartment C-1
sections.text: The C-1 compartment is located on level 7 next to the exit leading outside. The Compartment C-1 keycard is required to open it.

sections.heading: Reach the upper decks
sections.text: Exit the level 7 rooms using the code 3-1-2-2-2-0 and go upstairs to find the bridge.

sections.heading: Thaw the hatch on the roof of the bridge
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| BBQ-S43 gas torch | 1 | Used to thaw the hatch on the roof of the bridge. | N/A |
The hatch is located on the roof of the bridge, a frozen hatch with a frozen lever.

sections.heading: Find something to thaw the hatch on the roof of the bridge
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| BBQ-S43 gas torch | 1 | Used to thaw the hatch on the roof of the bridge. | N/A |

| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |

The Compartment C-1 keycard is required to enter the room.

sections.text: This objective completes once the player reaches the captain's body in the bridge on level 9.

| Hard drive from compartment C-1 (3) | 1 | Required | Yes |

Note: After handing over the drives, the quests A Wedge Between Us, Fresh Stock, Oil Change and War Never Changes become available. Completing them is not required to continue this story chapter.
